zh: 超市里整只热腾腾的烤鸡
比我们自己买回来生鸡做还方便
en: It is easier than cooking one yourself.

zh: 超市真的靠这只鸡赚钱吗
en: Does the store profit from the chicken?
Because what the store wants to sell you
may be much more than a chicken.

zh: 用低价商品吸引顾客进店

en: Other products can earn a contribution.

zh: 还买了沙拉饮料和面包
en: they also buy salad, drinks and bread.

zh: 扣掉十二美元的进货等变动成本
再减去烤鸡亏的一美元

en: But here is the crucial question.

zh: 顾客是不是因为便宜烤鸡
en: Did the cheap chicken cause shoppers
If they planned to buy them anyway
we cannot attribute all that contribution

zh: 这才是商业分析的重点
en: That is the key to business analysis.

zh: 它可能是一种引流工具

en: is not the profit on one chicken.
